source: Published opening-gap reversal. Apex adaptations are marked.
gap: First regular-session minute opens strictly below the prior session low, or strictly above the prior session high.
entry: Long if a later minute trades back through the prior low. Short if a later minute trades back through the prior high. Fill is the worse of the trigger and that minute's open.
stop: Long stop is the lowest price before the entry minute. Short stop is the highest price before the entry minute.
exit: Stop or the last regular-session minute close, whichever is reached first.
ambiguity: If the entry minute also reaches the stop, the trade is stopped. No profitable intrabar ordering is assumed.
data: Verified chronological SIP minute bars only. Daily bars are not a substitute.
